name: Bitbucket Data Center code review
description: Review each pull request opened or updated in a Bitbucket Data Center repository and post the findings as pull request comments. Runs on the Bitbucket Data Center integration built into OpenHands Enterprise.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A(["PR opened or updated"]) --> B["Clone the PR head"]
  B --> C["Agent reviews the changes"]
  C --> D["Findings posted as PR comments"]
exampleImplementation:
Trigger: the Bitbucket Data Center webhook that the instance's built-in Bitbucket Data Center integration installs on the repository and forwards to the automation service (source bitbucket_data_center).
Required built-in integration: Bitbucket Data Center under Settings > Integrations. The run receives the automation owner's Bitbucket Data Center credential as the bitbucket_data_center_token secret.

1. The filter matches pr:opened and pr:from_ref_updated events for non-draft pull requests targeting the configured repository, whose clone URL must end in /scm/<project key>/<repository slug> from the payload, ignoring case (the server's own clone links spell the project key in lower case). Each new head is reviewed once.
2. Anyone who can open or push to a pull request in that repository can start a review. The run uses the automation owner's Bitbucket Data Center connection and only reads the repository and writes pull request comments: it never pushes, approves or merges.
3. The agent fetches the pull request head, reviews the diff against its target branch, and posts a summary comment plus inline comments through the Bitbucket Data Center API.

source.label: Event source
source.help: Pull request events from the Bitbucket Data Center integration built into this instance.

on.label: Bitbucket events
on.help: Only pull requests opened or updated against the repository start a review.

repository.label: Repository
repository.help: The Bitbucket Data Center repository whose pull requests are reviewed. Pick it from your Bitbucket Data Center connection, or enter its HTTP clone URL.

reviewTone.label: Review tone
reviewTone.help: How detailed the review comments should be.

setup.prompt:
Review the Bitbucket Data Center pull request described in the event payload below, in the repository {{form.repository}}. Use a {{form.reviewTone}} review tone.

1. Unless the repository is already cloned in the workspace, clone it with the Bitbucket Data Center token you receive as the bitbucket_data_center_token secret (use the bitbucket-data-center skill for authentication). Fetch the pull request head with `git fetch origin refs/pull-requests/<id>/from` and check out the payload's fromRef.latestCommit.
2. Review the changes against the target branch for correctness, security, tests and maintainability. Run focused tests when they help confirm a finding.
3. Post the review through the Bitbucket Data Center REST API: inline comments on the lines that need changes, then one summary comment that names the reviewed commit.

Only read the repository and write pull request comments: never push, approve, decline or merge. If the pull request has no reviewable changes, post a short summary comment saying so.
setup.filter: (eventKey == 'pr:opened' || eventKey == 'pr:from_ref_updated') && pullRequest.draft != `true` && (ends_with(lower('{{form.repository}}'), lower(join('', ['/scm/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.project.key, '/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.slug, '.git']))) || ends_with(lower('{{form.repository}}'), lower(join('', ['/scm/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.project.key, '/', pullRequest.toRef.repository.slug]))))
setup.message: This deployment cannot create the Bitbucket Data Center review automation directly. Set it up in this conversation instead: confirm the repository's clone URL and the review tone, then create a prompt automation with an event trigger on the bitbucket_data_center source.
